item.title: Multiple gambling offenses added to Louisiana racketeering laws under new bill
item.description: HB53, filed by State Representative Bryan Fontenot, would retain all current definitions of racketeering with the addition of certain activities linked to gambling.

item.title: Warrant issued for sex offender registration violator in St. Landry Parish
item.description: The St. Landry Parish Sheriff's Office has issued a warrant for 65-year-old Anthony Roy Barker for sex offender registration violations. Barker is wanted for failing to renew his registration in person and failing to notify law enforcement of a change in his residency, officials said.
